name: Apple USB-C to Lightning Cable (1 m)
shortDescription: Apple's 1-metre USB-C to Lightning cable for charging and syncing iPhone and iPad with a Lightning port.
description:
Connects a Lightning iPhone or iPad to a USB-C power adapter or computer for charging and syncing. With an Apple USB-C power adapter of 18W or more it supports fast charging on compatible iPhone and iPad models.

The cable is 1 metre long.
highlights: Fast charging with an 18W or higher USB-C adapter
Charge and sync Lightning iPhone and iPad

items.label: iPhone
items.value: iPhone 14 and earlier models with a Lightning port

items.label: Fast charging
items.value: With Apple 18W, 20W, 29W, 30W, 61W, 87W or 96W USB-C power adapters
